create_resample_aggregate: create a resample aggregation on a Series or DataFrame to compute summary statistics over time periods
build_resample_upsample_fill: build an upsampled time series by forward filling or backward filling missing values at a higher frequency
test_resample_interpolate: test resampled time series interpolation with linear or time-based methods between target timestamps
refactor_resample_downsample: refactor a DatetimeIndex resampler to downsample data using sum, mean, min, max, or custom aggregation functions
review_TimeGrouper: review the TimeGrouper class for time-interval grouping with frequency, closed, label, origin, and offset parameters
